name: io.github.ryuamarines/url-normalizer
description: Normalize and dedupe URL lists. Paid, ready to run on Apify: apify.com/ryua_marines/url-normalizer

tools.name: url_normalizer
tools.description: Normalizes and deduplicates a list of URLs. x402 payment required (testnet USDC, Base Sepolia).

payment.description: x402 payment payload (base64 JSON), signed EIP-712 exact/transferWithAuthorization. Omit on the first call — the tool will return payment requirements (accepts[]) as an error result.
